payload.tension: The passage states community order joins peace, patience, joy, prayer, and testing. But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you, Abstain from every form of evil. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
